name: Shinoda Geppei
source:
Kouta's older brother, and the leader of the Shinoda family of exorcists.

Although his powers as an exorcist aren't something to be messed with, he has a huge flaw in that he's a massive brocon, and thinks Kouta is incredibly cute.

He has the power to subdue gods on his own, and is qualified as a "saniwa".
